    Hom minus Ext for presentations of projective dimension one #

    For a free presentation Aⁿ¹ → Aⁿ⁰ → Z → 0 with free relation rows, maps Z → W are the tuples in Wⁿ⁰ killed by the relations (homEvalEquiv), and Ext¹(Z, W) = Wⁿ¹ / F Wⁿ⁰. Hence dim Hom(Z, W) - dim Ext¹(Z, W) = (n₀ - n₁) dim W (finrank_hom_sub_ext1).
